mathematical_dependency: Published matching split/prime equivalence, local independent Poisson(1) limits and rare nonlocal decompositions, prime representation uniqueness, and geometric prime automorphism action are cited inputs. This report proves the reciprocal-fiber upper bound, recoverable-decoration lower bound, symmetry/deletion bounds, normalization, saturation consequences, connectivity correction and qualified inversion. A self-contained matching-forcing conditional coupling and immigration-death Poisson bound, with complete overlap counts and a logarithmic cutoff, yield relative O(1/n) graph counts and quantitative saturation.

fresh_package_checks.implementation: New standard-library Python code, independent of earlier exploratory and audit scripts. All packaged finite ranges are specified in companion/README.md and companion/evidence.json.
fresh_package_checks.purpose: Finite verification of formulas, examples, source data and algebra; not an asymptotic proof. Includes finite atomic-pattern and forcing conditional-law witnesses, and derived connected count c13=21593488017 by Euler inversion.

limitations: An individual O(1/n) error is proved, but no individual first correction coefficient is identified. The connected/all correction has O(n^-2) error. The numerical local-pattern total-variation bound min(1,200/n) does not supply an effective graph-count constant or onset.
Ceiling-safe inverse errors and their onset are asymptotic existence bounds, not effective finite-input certificates.
No external submission, author contact, public publication, or repository modification.
